taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-10 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 104.3 | 6.31 | 6.31
2 | 416.7 | 17.57 | 23.88
3 | 264.5 | 2.29 | 26.17
4 | 856.9 | 2.63 | 28.80
5 | 641.5 | 26.88 | 55.68
6 | 7698.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-10
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 23.88–26.17 m
Recommendation: The resistivity drop at Layer 3 (264.5 ohm-m) sandwiched between higher-resistivity layers suggests a saturated, water-bearing zone between approximately 23.9 m and 26.2 m depth. Advise the drilling team to core carefully through this interval and screen the well there, while being aware the zone is relatively thin (~2.3 m) and may require verification during drilling.
